name: lemondia
description: Read-only Lemondia business research: compare stored venue capacity and contact data against public web evidence for the venues selected on an inquiry.

interface.shortDescription: Read-only venue research for Lemondia inquiries
interface.longDescription: Loads the venues selected on a Lemondia inquiry over an OAuth-protected read-only MCP endpoint, researches each venue on the public web, and prints a per-field comparison of stored versus published capacity and contact data with source links. The plugin never writes to Lemondia.
defaultPrompt: Research the venues on Lemondia inquiry 3f1c2a54-9b7e-4d21-8c6f-5a0b1d2e3f44.
Compare our stored capacity against the venues' own sites for this inquiry link.
